We use optional chaining and nullish coalescing throughout, tsconfig target is ES2020, and there's no separate transpile-down step. `engine-baseline.md` attached for our build setup.
assertions: Identifies the cause as untranspiled optional chaining / nullish coalescing, not a webOS rendering bug, and says not to file it with LG

Explains why 2022+ LG works (Chromium 87+ supports ?. / ?? natively)

Fix is a real transpile-down / Babel target (~Chromium 79 or lower) covering node_modules, noting tsconfig target ES2020 emits ?. / ?? verbatim
